reasoning: REJECT on tile_structure_check hard gate. The tile_structure_ratio_per_view max is 20.22 (top view), which is > 14 and represents a delta of +2.087 vs. the prev-best baseline max of 18.132 (iter-094/095). This far exceeds the +0.3 ratchet threshold. These are identical tile_structure_ratio values to iter-096 (which was also REJECTed for this same reason: hero=18.893, side=17.365, top=20.219). The fp32-state-cb component of this iter was already disproved in iter-064 (REVERT, bit-identical ratio, +2.25% kernel). The L1 accumulator component appears to produce the same per-tile precision drift as iter-096's packer-l1-acc-d2. Kernel timing shows a real improvement (-1.39% vs prev_best), PSNR is acceptable (all views ≥ 38 dB floor), and visual checks all pass — but the tile_structure_ratio increase is a hard reject regardless of perf and PSNR wins.
